name: Hinata Mio
source:
A second-year student at Seirei Academy and Souta's classmate.

As a member of the track and field team, she is already showing ace-level performance as a second-year. She is a saving grace—an angel who treats Souta normally, even though the female students view him as an awkward/cringe-worthy oddball.

Bright, energetic, and able to get along with anyone, she is cherished by everyone as the class mascot. In reality, she is a huge fan of magical girl anime. She is a bit self-conscious about this hobby, considering it childish, so she keeps it hidden from others. She is deeply knowledgeable about tropes like being transported to another world or suddenly awakening to an unknown power one day. After sensing something unusual about Souta and Hazuki, she playfully becomes much more affectionate and clingy toward them.

Her favorite ramen is Hakodate Ichiban topped with stir-fried vegetables.

Favorite things: Sunday morning anime, justice, land
Disliked things: Ecchi things, studying

[Translated from the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/sprinkle/character/chara3.php#chara-main]official website[/url]]
